# Onboarding interviews (6 participants, Sept 2026)

P1 — Product designer. "It took me forty minutes before I put the first idea down. I kept fiddling with settings." Loves keyboard shortcuts once found. Asked for research templates.

P2 — PM. "Our AI tools dump text; someone has to clean it up afterwards." Would trust an agent more if she could see it working. Wants FigJam import.

P3 — Researcher. "A blank canvas makes me freeze." Clusters by colour. Needs to undo everything an agent did in one go.

P4 — Engineer. Connected Claude Code in a minute, but the first board was messy. "I want it tidy without touching it."

P5 — Founder. Shares boards as images with investors. "If it looks sloppy I won't send it."

P6 — Designer. Took 35 minutes to get to a first useful board. Wants comments the agent can read and act on.
